outOfScope: Migrating, deleting or cutting over any current unfinished legacy Blackboard task.
Rewriting DONE task history or Living Docs.
constraints: Task 1 builds the new control plane only. It must not migrate or cut over any current unfinished legacy work.
Blackboard authority must be readable identically from any checkout/worktree and must not depend on whichever source branch is currently checked out.
A new Work must be creatable directly in the control plane before any source PR or branch exists.
Context is derived output, not authority: no context generation/history/currentContextRef persistence in the V2 model.
Source branches, worktrees and candidate SHAs are attempt bindings only and never become Blackboard truth.
Independent Jev judgment, exact candidate/evidence/merge binding, negative-case verification and Living Docs delivery truth remain trust primitives; V2 may adapt them but must not weaken them.
The lifecycle and legal next actions must be executable state-machine data/code; operator docs may explain semantics but cannot be required to infer what action is legal next.
invariants: Exactly one configured authority owns Work; reads from different checkouts are equivalent during a quiescent resourceVersion and never fall back to Git branch data.
Work.generation increments only on semantic spec changes; resourceVersion covers every status/spec mutation and stale decisions never apply.
Store-clock leases and persistent monotonic fences reject stale mutations; actor time cannot authorize takeover; read-only operations need no Attempt fence.
All lifecycle actions have executable guards, and pure nextActions/context consume only explicit immutable snapshot facts.
Actor-authored candidate/evidence records cannot alter spec, judge correctness or publish delivery; exact trusted Decision/receipt binding is required.
BB-155 creates only new synthetic V2 Work and leaves legacy current-work authority and all task records unchanged.
Contexts are derived values without stored identity/history; read-only phases grant zero product-source write authority.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Isolated Node24+ V2 service only; no legacy import/cutover or dual-write. Choose server-owned SQLite on local disk, outside all source checkouts. Reject Git-ref authority because remote Git CAS supplies no trusted lease clock.

D2 — Export SqliteBlackboardControlStore with readSnapshot/createWork/apply/readRecord. WAL+synchronous FULL+foreign keys+5s busy timeout; BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes all guarded writes, CAS expected resourceVersion/generation and COMMIT records+Work atomically. No client SQL or multi-host/NFS direct database writes. Pin external service authorityId/controller digest; no cwd fallback.

D3 — Work={id,resourceVersion,generation,spec,status}; generation is on Work, not spec. Operator semantic revision increments generation and revokes readiness/Attempt. Research PUBLISH_PLAN atomically increments generation, retires old Research Attempt, rotates token/fence to new generation and enters PLAN_JUDGMENT. Identical plan is idempotent. AllSAT consumes Research ownership before a new implementation claim. Status/candidate changes increment RV only.

D4 — Trusted service clock sampled within transaction, with durable lastCommittedTime and CLOCK_REGRESSION fail-closed after restart. Request time never decides expiry. Lease interval ends at now>=leaseUntil; renew requires live current token, takeover requires expiry. Durable per-Work fenceCounter never resets on semantic revision. Attempt effects validate live id/generation/fence/owner before any write; reads need reader identity only.

D5 — lifecycle.mjs alone defines guarded executable transitions and pure nextActions(snapshot). Snapshot supplies exact Work plus immutable Decision/record/dependency/lease facts; no clock/I/O/hidden state. Service-owned reconciliation observes expiry/dependency truth. Apply repeats guards, so stale next output grants no authority. Failed candidate blocks SUPERVISION_REQUIRED until BB-157 adds LOOKBACK; never direct repair.

D6 — Pure buildContext(snapshot,systemFacts) consumes lifecycle result and resolved immutable component/Living facts. Return goal, inputs, scopes, forbidden actions/output/bindings; persist no context identity/history/file. Only fenced execution/repair grants exact plan product scope; research permits current plan only and judgments/blocked/merge are read-only.

D7 — Immutable Attempt identity binds Work generation/spec, owner/fence/lease and source base/ref/worktree. Candidate/evidence versions append exact facts only, never change spec or correctness. All mutating Attempt effects use current live token; source processes may continue after expiry but stale outputs cannot enter authority/publication. Actor payload unknown fields reject.

D8 — Independent judge capability plus existing pinned validateEvaluation/negative-case/trust adapters owns JevDecision. Exact required answers/model/policy/stateHash/specHash/cacheKey and current generation/spec/Attempt/candidate/evidence bind publication. Stale trusted Decision is immutable SUPERSEDED without Work changes; forged/malformed authority rejects. Same record id requires identical bytes. Dispatch reservation is unique by exact subject/cache key.

D9 — MERGE_PENDING becomes DELIVERED only after trusted exact candidate ancestor/merge/main/evaluated-tree/unchanged-source/Living receipt checks. Receipt binds Work generation/spec/Attempt/Decision and immutable evidence. Source scripts cannot replace controller or validator semantics; command success/producer text is never delivery.

D10 — Authenticated loopback HTTP service with external0600 tokens and reader/actor/judge/operator roles,1MiB body/30s request bounds. External absolute config/BB_CONTROL_URL must match authorityId; wrong/unreachable authority fails. Export import-safe createControlClient; package bin bb supports create/show/next/context/serve/apply with npm bb:v2 alias. V2-opaque new ids work before any source branch/PR. Remote TLS is a separate operator precondition, no public deployment here.
implementationSlices: S1 — control-store.mjs/work-resource.mjs: implement strict Work/spec/status/record schemas and server-owned SQLite transaction store described by D2-D4. Expose readSnapshot/createWork/apply/readRecord, never raw replacement. BEGIN IMMEDIATE, unique allocation, expected RV/generation CAS, durable lastCommittedTime and per-Work fenceCounter, server-clock leases, exact idempotence and rollback. Semantic revision invalidates current readiness/Attempt without resetting fence. Reject unknown actor fields and stale tokens before record or status writes. No Git-ref authority or actor-clock expiry.

S2 — lifecycle.mjs: implement the eight explicit transition rows D5 and declared pure nextActions contract. Guards cover phase, spec/plan completeness, current independent readiness, direct Work/Living dependency facts, exact current Attempt, candidate/evidence/Decision/receipt binding. Failed candidate -> BLOCKED/SUPERVISION_REQUIRED; no direct repair. All effects go through apply and repeat guards with store clock/fence. Store-owned dependency/lease reconciliation produces canonical observed facts; pure next has no clock/I/O. Reserve LOOKBACK/reflection extension for BB-157 without implementing supervision here. PUBLISH_PLAN follows explicit generation+Research Attempt rotation; allSAT readiness consumes that ownership before a fresh implementation claim. Test zero-visible-gap rotation, old token rejection and identical-plan idempotence.

S3 — context-builder.mjs: implement pure buildContext(snapshot,systemFacts), immutable binding projection and phase-local scopes D6. Read-only judgment/block/merge contexts expose no product writes; research permits only current plan data; executable Worker requires exact plan/readiness/dependency/lease facts. No context file/currentContextRef/history or source-directory discovery. Reader resolves component/Living blobs before projection.

S4 — server.mjs/cli.mjs: start Node24+ authenticated loopback authority from an external absolute local-disk DB/token/config. Pin authorityId/controller digest; create/show/next/context and POST guarded action surface D10. Canonical show output contains no cwd/read timestamp, and wrong/missing authority never falls back to branch graph. New Work create/start research needs no Git branch or PR. Bound sizes/timeouts and role separation; do not deploy remote/public service. Expose exact bb create/show/next/context via package.json bin bb (and npm bb:v2 alias); import-safe client factory remains createControlClient.

S5 — trust-adapter.mjs/test/blackboard-v2-control.test.mjs: use existing pinned validators for exact independent Jev and delivery receipts; immutable Decision insert/status CAS is atomic, stale subjects SUPERSEDED with unchanged Work. Test actual SQLite multi-process CAS, restart clock rollback, takeover/fence, actor-field injection, two different checkout CLI reads, complete table transitions, pure no-I/O contexts, forged/stale decision/receipt and no source/legacy mutation. Update only declared Living state and package scripts. Prototype scratch model is feasibility evidence, not product implementation or real Jev authority. Implement the six literal N1-N6 titles with the actual exported symbols and direct observations in testContract. No GitRefBlackboardControlStore exists in the selected architecture.

livingDocs.statement: Living system state records the delivered V2 Blackboard control-plane boundary, dedicated authority, executable lifecycle and pure context-builder semantics while legacy work remains uncutover.

selection.config: absolute external JSON {url,authorityId}; explicit environment override must still match authorityId
selection.database: server-owned absolute local-disk path, parent 0700/file0600; reject paths inside source checkout/.git/worktrees
selection.transport: HTTP 127.0.0.1; service rejects non-loopback bind unless separately installed trusted TLS; body max1MiB; request timeout30s; no network lookup from repository config
selection.authentication: out-of-checkout 0600 token file; capabilities reader/actor/judge/operator; compare opaque tokens safely; never emit secrets; distinct actor and independent judge identities

authorityContract.schema: metadata(authorityId,schemaVersion,controllerDigest,authorityMode,lastCommittedTime,allocationNextId); works(id PRIMARY KEY,resourceVersion,generation,specJson,statusJson,fenceCounter); attempts(id PRIMARY KEY,workId,generation,canonicalJson); records(id PRIMARY KEY,kind,workId,generation,hash,canonicalJson). Foreign keys and uniqueness enforce exact identities. All backing state is service authority, not Git.
authorityContract.transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> schema/auth/action validation -> sample trusted service Date.now -> CLOCK_REGRESSION check against durable lastCommittedTime -> compare expected resourceVersion/generation -> current lease/fence/subject checks -> records+Work+allocation update -> update lastCommittedTime -> COMMIT. Any exception ROLLBACK including allocation and inserted receipts. Busy timeout returns RETRYABLE_BUSY without effects. No unguarded file replace.
authorityContract.clock: Production clock cannot be supplied in request. Injectable test clock exists only at server construction in test harness. Positive safe-integer ttl range1000..3600000ms; lease expires at now>=leaseUntil. Renew requires same current owner/Attempt/fence and unexpired lease; takeover only after store time expiry. Process restart reopens same database, never resets lastCommittedTime/fenceCounter. Clock rollback blocks mutating operations; show remains readable.
api: POST /v2/works {id?:V2-opaque in isolated mode,spec} operator allocation/create; BB-n allowed only after cutover
Operator command bb is package.json bin -> scripts/blackboard-v2/cli.mjs; bb create/show/next/context plus bb serve/apply. npm run bb:v2 is an alias, not a separate authority.
authorityContract.result: canonical Work show contains no read timestamp/cwd/connection-local data. Quiescent reads have identical bytes. Error codes distinguish NOT_FOUND, WRONG_AUTHORITY, UNAUTHORIZED, CAS_CONFLICT, LEASE_HELD, STALE_FENCE, CLOCK_REGRESSION, PHASE_FORBIDDEN and RETRYABLE_BUSY. Mutations never accept full actor-authored Work replacement.

resourceContract.Work: {id:BB-n after cutover or V2-opaque in isolated mode,resourceVersion:positiveInteger,generation:positiveInteger,spec:{labels?:{title,kind,complexity,featureId,expectedOutputs},provenance?:{legacySnapshotSha,legacyTaskHash,importReceiptRef},objective:{ref,hash,body},plan:{ref,semanticHash,body}|null,dependencies:[{workId,requires,source:WORK|LIVING,binding?}],components:[id],writeScope:[path],forbiddenWrite:[path]},status:{phase,observedGeneration,activeAttemptRef|null,readinessDecisionRef|null,latestCandidateDecisionRef|null,conditions:[{type,observedGeneration,subjectRef,subjectHash,reason}],dependencyFacts:[{workId,state,refs,hash}],leaseState:NONE|LIVE|EXPIRED,blockers:[code]}}. Strict keys/types; stable sort by ids; uniqueness and acyclicity checked in store transaction.
resourceContract.generation: Create generation1/RV1. Operator REVISE_SPEC changes semantic input, increments generation, revokes readiness/active Attempt, enters RESEARCHING, preserves fenceCounter. Fenced RESEARCH-role PUBLISH_PLAN is also a semantic change: validate exact objective/current predecessor, store new plan, increment generation, retire old Research Attempt and atomically allocate replacement Research Attempt bound to NEW generation/specHash with fenceCounter+1, same owner and store-clock lease; enter PLAN_JUDGMENT in that same transaction. Return the new token. Identical plan bytes are idempotent and do not increment generation/dispatch again. AllSAT readiness consumes Research ownership, clears activeAttemptRef and enters READY; CLAIM_EXECUTION creates a new IMPLEMENTATION Attempt only after readiness/dependency guards. Status/candidate/evidence changes increment RV only. Optional strict labels/provenance are operator metadata; candidate payload cannot change spec.
resourceContract.records: Attempt/Decision/DeliveryReceipt bodies live in the same store. Immutable refs use {kind,id,hash}; raw evidence blobs retain exact immutable external refs/hashes. Candidate/evidence versions are append-only records, while status contains only current refs. No context state. Record insertion conflicting existing id/hash rejects; equal insertion is idempotent.

lifecycleContract.pureSignature: nextActions(snapshot) -> {actions:[{id,requiredInputs,preconditions}],blockers:[{code,refs}],forbidden:[actionId]}; snapshot includes exact Work id/generation/resourceVersion/spec/status and resolved immutable Decisions/record facts. Canonical ordering; no random ids, clock, I/O or hidden controller state. apply repeats table guards and transaction-owned fences/clock.
transitions: PROPOSED + START_RESEARCH -> RESEARCHING; actor RESEARCH role, valid objective/components and expected RV/generation; store-clock claim allocates first Research Attempt/fence. No source branch or dependency DONE prerequisite.

RESEARCHING + PUBLISH_PLAN -> PLAN_JUDGMENT; current Research role/live token and complete exact-objective-bound plan. New semantic plan increments Work generation and atomically replaces Research Attempt/token to bind new generation/spec; identical plan bytes are idempotent. No intermediate old-generation PLAN_JUDGMENT state.

PLAN_JUDGMENT + PUBLISH_DECISION -> READY only all required independent claims SATISFIED; consume Research ownership/clear activeAttempt; all other outcomes -> RESEARCHING without granting Worker source scope. Fresh generation/spec/Research Attempt/plan hash and judge capability mandatory.

READY + CLAIM_EXECUTION -> EXECUTING only current readiness and all direct WORK dependencies DELIVERED / external LIVING facts validated. Research may run ahead; Worker never bypasses dependency blockers.
EXECUTING/REPAIRING + PUBLISH_CANDIDATE -> JUDGING only current lease/fence and exact candidate/evidence subject; agent output cannot satisfy criteria.

JUDGING + PUBLISH_DECISION -> MERGE_PENDING for all SATISFIED; PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION -> RESEARCHING and revoke readiness; other non-satisfied -> BLOCKED reason SUPERVISION_REQUIRED in BB-155. BB-157 extends this edge with LOOKBACK; no direct REPAIRING edge.
MERGE_PENDING + PUBLISH_DELIVERY_RECEIPT -> DELIVERED only exact trusted merge/main/tree/Living validation; no direct DONE from a success command.

BLOCKED exposes reason and guarded operator/research action only; no source write; a trusted lease reconciliation may expose TAKE_OVER with exact transaction recheck. DELIVERED terminal mutation rejected.
lifecycleContract.extension: Base declares status record refs and action dispatch extension seam. BB-157 adds LOOKBACK/PUBLISH_REFLECTION in lifecycle.mjs using supervision validation; no change to CAS/clock/fence implementation is needed. The core has no actor bypass around apply(action).
lifecycleContract.leaseReconciliation: Service controller observes expiry and direct dependency delivery into canonical status using a guarded store transaction. It uses store time and no actor fence because it owns control observation, not Attempt outputs. Spec/generation never change. Before reconciliation an action may be blocked; mutation guards always reject expired tokens independently.

contextContract.signature: buildContext(snapshot,systemFacts) -> {goal,inputs,readScope,writeScope,forbidden,requiredOutput,bindings}; snapshot includes Work id/generation/RV/spec/status plus resolved immutable records/Decisions. Caller resolves Living/component/source facts beforehand; builder never reads disk, scans directories, mutates store or persists output.
contextContract.routing: PROPOSED/RESEARCHING uses current objective/current plan only and output READY_IMPLEMENT_PLAN; writes only research plan. PLAN_JUDGMENT/JUDGING/MERGE_PENDING/BLOCKED has empty product writeScope and exact judgment/evidence/merge inputs. EXECUTING/REPAIRING yields exact plan scope only when current readiness, dependencies and live Attempt status facts hold; server rechecks live fence on effects. DELIVERED has only Living truth and no writable action.
contextContract.binding: Output includes exact Work spec/generation, resolved record hashes and system-fact hashes as evidence binding, not a Context identity/generation. It contains no createdAt, parent context, currentContextRef or history chain. Repeated builds on immutable inputs are byte-equivalent.

trustContract.Attempt: {id,workId,workGeneration,specHash,kind:RESEARCH|IMPLEMENTATION,owner,fence,issuedAt,leaseUntil,baseSha?,sourceRef?,worktree?,candidateVersionRefs:[ref],evidenceVersionRefs:[ref]}. Actor may append only named source identity/evidence fields through guarded actions, cannot mutate Work/lease/fence or replace earlier records.
trustContract.Decision: {id,workId,observedGeneration,specHash,attemptRef,subject:{objectiveHash,planHash,candidateSha?,candidateTree?,evidenceSetHash?},jev:{model,policy,stateHash,specHash,cacheKey,answers,evaluationRef/evaluationHash},storeSequence,publication:APPLIED|SUPERSEDED}. Sequence assigned inside store transaction, not actor timestamp. Independent trusted adapter validates all required answers and evaluation bindings; model/policy and outcomes stay delivered existing policy.
trustContract.publication: Check exact Work generation+spec hash+current Attempt identity/fence+exact current candidate/evidence and phase under CAS. Stale but structurally valid trusted Decision is immutable SUPERSEDED and never changes Work status/phase/conditions. Wrong capability or forged/malformed receipts reject rather than retaining purported correctness. Concurrent spec edit vs Decision application serializes into one winner; loser cannot resurrect readiness.
trustContract.DeliveryReceipt: Existing trusted verifyDelivery-equivalent checks execute in pinned controller adapter over exact immutable source objects: candidate ancestor of actual merge; merge ancestor of observed main; evaluated candidate tree==merge tree; declared required source/Living blobs unchanged; trusted all-SATISFIED candidate Decision binds same Work/Attempt. Receipt has candidateSha,candidateTree,mergeSha,observedMainSha,planHash,evidenceHash,decisionRef,consolidatedRefs. Missing Git object or invalid bound evidence is blocker, never inferred PASS.
trustContract.adapters: New trust-adapter.mjs imports existing delivered canonical/hash, validateEvaluation, negative-case and delivery validators from pinned controller installation. Candidate checkout supplies bytes/data only; its scripts never define control lifecycle or Jev semantics. Any adapter needs explicit root/snapshot bound to subject; no root inferred from client cwd. Provider dispatch is reserved once by exact Work generation/Attempt/candidate/evidence/cacheKey in CAS; BB-157 further restricts material retry.
trustContract.limits: Prototype synthetic Decisions test binding/control safety only; no new real SATISFIED result is claimed by this plan. Trusted receipts, real Jev and exact merge verification remain required in Worker evidence.

coexistenceContract.mode: BB-155 authorityMode=ISOLATED_NEW_WORK accepts V2-opaque ids in its authority namespace only. It cannot create/import/claim BB-n legacy ids; no legacy graph reader or dual-write is needed. After BB-156 atomic import/cutover, allocator switches to BB-n using validated legacy next-id plus all stored-id uniqueness. Existing isolated V2 Work remain separate non-colliding ids.
coexistenceContract.deliveryBoundary: BB-155 Worker tests a separate ISOLATED_NEW_WORK service and new V2 ids only; no import/cutover action is registered in that release. BB-156 owns the migration-only module/selector transaction and external freeze. Combined research reproduction has separately named scratch migration tests for BB-156, not a BB-155 product migration. BB-157 owns LOOKBACK/reflection policy. Delivered API divergence reopens research.

Actor future clock cannot expire lease; store-clock equality permits takeover; stale fence rejected
After restart store-clock regression fails closed

researchSummary.limits: Scratch model deliberately exercises selected risks. It omits production auth, full strict schemas, trust-adapter provider dispatch and real receipt verification. researchSummary.replayRef: researchReproduction contains full hash-bound source, tests and actual output; compressed bytes are data only, never an authority receipt.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: From two different source checkouts/worktrees, `bb show <WORK_ID>` resolves byte-equivalent authoritative Work state from one control-plane authority.
A brand-new work item can be created and enter research without first merging a source-code registration PR.
The V2 Work resource separates desired semantic state from observed lifecycle state and provides an explicit revision/generation binding for stale judgment detection.
`bb next <WORK_ID>` derives the bounded legal next actions and blockers from executable lifecycle state without requiring jev.md or previous conversation.
`buildContext(<WORK_ID>)` derives the current agent goal, inputs, read/write authority, forbidden actions and required output without persisting a context artifact.
Source branch/worktree/candidate identity is recorded only as an Attempt bound to a Work and cannot redefine the Work objective/plan or lifecycle authority.
V2 can run against empty/new Work resources in parallel with the legacy Blackboard, with no migration or dual-write of current legacy tasks in this task.

researchReproduction.extract: Decode each gzipBase64 into named files under an owned scratch directory. Set V2_RESEARCH_SOURCE_ROOT to a Git repository containing exact d795bca0e1865685d6b11b66de12224691446897 objects; execute node --test probe.test.mjs. Legacy graph and routing source are read with git show at that immutable SHA, not from current checkout. All service databases/config/Git worktrees are owned scratch and disposed.

bootstrapContract.create: POST /v2/works operator capability atomically validates supplied objective/components/dependency ids and allocates new id from durable allocation row or validates explicit unoccupied id. Insert Work generation1/resourceVersion1/PROPOSED and allocation advance in the same SQLite transaction; failure rolls back both. No sourceRef/baseSha/PR is required.
bootstrapContract.researchEntry: ControlStore.apply action START_RESEARCH checks expected RV/generation and current PROPOSED/objective completeness, creates the RESEARCH Attempt under store-clock lease/fence, enters RESEARCHING and increments RV only. Pure next names that action from PROPOSED without dependency-DONE requirements. It permits only current plan research publication, not source mutation or READY selfacceptance. First plan publication is explicitly the resourceContract generation-rotation transaction; Work creation/research entry remain generation1. CLI receives new token after semantic plan publication.
bootstrapContract.controls: Actual product create+start fixture must snapshot legacy graph/artifact refs, source HEAD/status before/after and assert byte equality. New Work is readable by a second configured client with no checkout/PR. Invalid components, cyclic dependencies, duplicate id and competing allocation reject atomically.

testContract.N1: Call createControlClient for one service/authority; spawn actual cli.mjs show from two Git checkouts on different branches. Assert canonical show bytes identical; wrong authorityId and local fake work-graph cannot affect result.
testContract.N2: Invoke SqliteBlackboardControlStore.apply(CLAIM/RENEW/TAKE_OVER) through eight separate clients; one claim winner, seven CAS failures. Test actor forged time ignored, service test clock before/equal expiry, durable increasing fence after generation/restart and rollback clock rejection.
testContract.N3: Publish exact test-trust Decision via actual apply; race semantic edit against publication. Old generation/spec/Attempt/candidate/evidence => SUPERSEDED with unchanged phase/conditions/Work bytes; current trusted allSAT applies. A synthetic judge fixture is isolated test data, not production acceptance.
